jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Company Description

HumanizedText is an AI-powered writing platform that helps make AI-generated content more natural and readable. We build AI writing, humanization, grammar, tone, and developer tools for creators, professionals, students, and developers.

Role Description

We’re looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join our remote engineering team. You’ll work on real product features, backend services, APIs, debugging, and AI-powered tools while learning from experienced engineers.

Qualifications

Strong foundational knowledge in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and basic software engineering concepts.
Practical experience or coursework in Software Development and Programming, with proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, or similar).
Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and ability to apply them to design and implement modular, reusable code.
Exposure to Back-End Web Development, such as working with APIs, databases, or server-side frameworks, is preferred.
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Ability to work effectively in a remote setting, manage time independently, and communicate clearly in written and spoken English.
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and basic software development tools; interest in learning modern development workflows and best practices.
Curiosity, problem-solving mindset, and willingness to learn from feedback and collaborate with a diverse engineering team.

Show less

Job function

Industries
